text: This is a clean medical clinic. Overall, it's good. I brought my girlfriend here for breast correction. She had it done elsewhere. It wasn't painful, there were no problems, and she healed quickly. She recovered very quickly. She can dress up nicely without having to wait long. 👍😎 It's located on Pattaya Klang Road, Soi 3. It's easy to see. Just follow the pin.

8 months have passed. My left nipple is slightly higher, but it's acceptable. *I want to share my experience. The clinic offered a referral fee, and a fee for submitting a review!!! I didn't get anything.
Issue 1. I recommended a friend to have the procedure done, but I admit that I didn't have it done myself. I fulfilled all the clinic's terms and conditions, so I didn't get the referral fee. It was almost 5,000 baht because my friend had the expensive silicone implants.
Issue 2. The clinic asked me to send a video and still photos showing my breasts clearly to get a 5,000 baht review fee. After sending them, I waited for a month and received no response. When I followed up, they said the video wasn't good enough. Even if I deleted the photos and videos from Line, I could only delete them from my device; the clinic's address would still be there. In short, I didn't get a single baht and I'm very disappointed. I won't recommend them to anyone again. Anyone looking for a cosmetic surgery clinic and wanting to inquire, feel free to contact me. I'm happy to provide advice for those considering breast augmentation.
